nodes.label: Registration v3 Dual Payments Plan
nodes.rationale: No new payment ledger — competition_events audit remains the money trail; Stripe network calls always happen outside sql.begin transactions.

nodes.label: platform_settings + fee chain
nodes.rationale: Superuser-only table with no app_user grant, so no RLS is needed; chain is org override -> plan entitlement -> platform_settings -> env PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT -> 5.

nodes.label: Per-Division payment_method Axis
nodes.rationale: Registrant-facing copy says 'card' / 'pay the organiser', never 'Stripe'/'offline'; the method and the amount are snapshotted onto the registration so live settings edits never move an existing entry's price.

nodes.label: 48h Pay Window + sweepRegistrations cron
nodes.rationale: Hourly cron-shaped endpoint: T-24h reminders with a fresh checkout link, then expiry and waitlist promotion in one row-locked transaction per registration; reminded_at stays null when the email throws so the next sweep retries.

nodes.label: Late/Duplicate Payment Hardening
nodes.rationale: A payment landing on a withdrawn/expired row, or a second session with a different intent, is auto-refunded with reverse_transfer + refund_application_fee rather than silently recorded.

nodes.label: handleRegistrationDispute
nodes.rationale: Looks the registration up by payment_intent_id, so disputes on non-entry-fee charges fall through silently by design.

nodes.label: Money Records Block Hard Delete
nodes.rationale: Money records must outlive mistakes: a division with any unrefunded card payment 409s with REGISTRATION_PAYMENTS and offers archive instead.
